failures.title: Citroen EB2ADTED Engine Problems - What Actually Fails

items.title: Wet Timing Belt Degradation (The "Belt in Oil" Issue)
items.whatHappens: The EB2ADTED retains the EB2 family's design of running the timing belt inside the engine oil to reduce friction. Over time, or if the incorrect engine oil specification is used, the belt material degrades and sheds rubber particles. These particles circulate and block the oil pickup strainer in the sump, leading to severe oil starvation. This often manifests first as a stiff brake pedal (due to vacuum pump starvation) before progressing to catastrophic engine bearing failure and seizure.
items.repairVsReplace: If caught early via a drop in oil pressure or brake servo issues, the sump can be removed, the strainer cleaned, and the belt replaced. However, if the engine has already suffered oil starvation damage (indicated by bearing knock), a full reconditioned Citroen EB2ADTED engine replacement is the only reliable fix.

items.title: Mild-Hybrid (MHEV) System & BISG Issues
items.whatHappens: The addition of the 48-volt Belt-Integrated Starter Generator (BISG) introduces new points of failure. Software calibration glitches, inverter faults, or mechanical wear in the BISG unit can trigger drivetrain malfunction warnings, force the vehicle into limp mode, or prevent the engine from restarting after an auto-stop event.
items.repairVsReplace: Many MHEV issues are resolved with Citroen software updates or targeted component replacement. However, if the BISG failure is severe and integrated deeply with the engine assembly, a full unit swap may be required, particularly if the vehicle is out of warranty.

items.title: Oil Dilution from GPF Regeneration
items.whatHappens: During active Gasoline Particulate Filter (GPF) regeneration, small amounts of unburnt fuel can wash past the piston rings and dilute the engine oil. If oil change intervals are strictly followed to the standard long-life schedule, the diluted oil loses its protective properties, accelerating wear on the turbocharger bearings and main crankshaft bearings, while simultaneously accelerating wet belt degradation.
items.repairVsReplace: This is primarily managed through strict, shortened oil change intervals (every 5,000-7,500 miles). If bearing wear has already occurred and a low oil pressure warning is present, a full reconditioned engine replacement is required to guarantee reliability.

failures.goodYearsLine: Post-2020 revisions of the EB2ADTED saw improved belt materials and updated ECU oil-level monitoring, making them slightly less prone to rapid belt degradation. However, the fundamental "belt in oil" architecture remains a point of vigilance, and strict adherence to PSA-approved low-SAPS engine oil is non-negotiable .

variants.title: How to Confirm You Have the EB2ADTED
variants.intro: As a Specific page type with no distinct sub-codes listed in the inventory, this section focuses on accurate identification and avoiding common, costly misidentifications. The EB2ADTED engine code is stamped on a machined pad on the cylinder block and is also recorded on your vehicle’s V5C registration document under "Engine Number". Owners and breakers frequently confuse the EB2ADTED with its non-hybrid siblings, the EB2ADT (110hp) and the EB2ADTS (130hp). While all three share the same 1.2-litre 3-cylinder PureTech block architecture, the EB2ADTED is uniquely distinguished by its 48-volt mild-hybrid electrical architecture, the presence of the Belt-Integrated Starter Generator (BISG), and specific ECU calibration. Fitting an EB2ADT or EB2ADTS wiring harness, ECU, or ancillary components to an EB2ADTED host will result in incorrect fueling, persistent hybrid fault codes, and a non-running vehicle.

buyingGuide.title: Buying a Replacement EB2ADTED - What to Choose

options.label: Used
options.body: A used Citroen EB2ADTED engine for sale can be a viable, budget-friendly option for newer C4 or C5 Aircross projects, but it carries a severe inherent risk. Unless the seller can provide documented proof that the wet timing belt has been replaced recently with the correct PSA-approved part, the oil pickup strainer has been inspected, and the 48V hybrid system is fully functional, you are highly likely to be inheriting a ticking time bomb of belt degradation or hybrid faults. Learn more about used engines.

options.label: Reconditioned
options.body: For most owners, a reconditioned Citroen EB2ADTED is the only sensible choice. A proper recon will proactively address the engine’s known weaknesses by fitting a brand-new timing belt kit, replacing the tensioners, ensuring the oil pickup strainer is completely free of debris, and verifying the health of the BISG unit, delivering peace of mind for the future. Explore reconditioned engine options.

options.label: Rebuilt
options.body: A full rebuild is justified for low-mileage C5 Aircross or late-model C4 projects where the engine is being stripped to the bare block. This allows for new piston rings to address oil consumption, comprehensive decarbonisation, and verification of the turbocharger and hybrid integration points, ensuring the engine matches the pristine condition of the host chassis. View rebuilt engine services.

buyingGuide.supplyFitLine: Sourcing and fitting your replacement through our vetted network ensures the work is completed by specialists familiar with PSA PureTech systems, wet-belt procedures, and 48V hybrid recalibration, backed by a nationwide warranty. Check supply and fit availability.
buyingGuide.vehicleValueNote: Modern Citroen C4 and C5 Aircross models (2018+) typically hold strong values between £10,000 and £25,000, depending on mileage, specification, and condition . Because a fully fitted, reconditioned Citroen EB2ADTED engine replacement (£2,050-£3,150) represents a small fraction of the host vehicle's value, replacement is a financially sound decision. The replacement cost is well within the vehicle's value band, making this a safe and viable repair for almost all examples.

items.question: What is the most common failure on the Citroen EB2ADTED engine?
items.answer: The most critical failure on the EB2ADTED is wet timing belt degradation, where the belt material breaks down and sheds rubber particles into the engine oil, blocking the oil pickup strainer and causing severe oil starvation. Additionally, the 48V MHEV system's Belt-Integrated Starter Generator (BISG) can suffer from software or inverter faults, triggering limp mode. Oil dilution from GPF regeneration can also accelerate bearing wear if service intervals are not strictly shortened.

items.question: Which Citroen models use the EB2ADTED engine?
items.answer: The EB2ADTED 1.2-litre PureTech Hybrid engine was introduced in 2018 and is fitted to modern Citroen family crossovers. It serves as the primary 1.2-litre mild-hybrid petrol powerplant across the Citroen C4 Hybrid and C5 Aircross lineups. It was designed to improve real-world fuel economy and provide smoother stop-start functionality via the 48V electrical architecture.

items.question: Should I buy a used or reconditioned EB2ADTED engine?
items.answer: For any modern Citroen hybrid, a reconditioned EB2ADTED is strongly recommended over a used unit. Used engines frequently inherit the same degraded timing belt, blocked oil pickup strainer, or 48V BISG faults that prompted the original removal. A proper reconditioned build proactively installs a brand-new PSA-approved timing belt kit, clears the oil galleries, and verifies the health of the hybrid integration points. Reconditioned units also include comprehensive compression and oil pressure testing to guarantee reliability.

items.answer: You can confirm your engine code by checking the V5C registration document under the "Engine Number" field or by locating the code stamped on the cylinder block. The EB2ADTED is easily distinguished from the non-hybrid EB2ADT (110hp) and EB2ADTS (130hp) by its specific 48V Belt-Integrated Starter Generator (BISG) and hybrid ECU calibration. Fitting an EB2ADT or EB2ADTS wiring harness or ECU to an EB2ADTED host will result in incorrect fueling, persistent hybrid fault codes, and a non-running vehicle.
